convention: Existing pixel-center linspace(-1+1/W,1-1/W) base grid, flow normalized by (W-1)/2,(H-1)/2; grid_sample align_corners=False; positive dx samples to the right; bilinear zero padding; sampled appended-one mask >0.999. Zero flow preserves the image within floating interpolation precision. Pixel flow normalization uses W-1/H-1 as in the existing implementation; preserved explicitly.
denominator: All H*W*3 image elements; invalid positions have zero warped reconstruction, not removed from the L1 denominator
